# Launch Screen Assets

The upcoming 0.19.1 retains this launch artwork with a neutral launch background.
These assets are separate from the launcher icons; `scripts/generate-branding.py`
does not regenerate them. See the [interface specification](../../../../../docs/interface-design.md)
and [iOS deployment guide](../../../../../docs/ios-deployment-guide.md#5-icons-and-launch-screens).

Make any future asset/storyboard changes on the capable iOS development machine
and verify them on a physical device. Do not start a simulator on the Intel Mac.
